title: Meeting the voice of Flo, Jenifer Lewis!

author: Pixar
description:
Join us as we celebrate the Cars 20th anniversary and 100 years of Route 66 while we recreate the original Cars research trip the Pixar team took 25 years ago. @jofranco,  travel content creator, picks up Bill Cone, Production Designer (Sets), in Texas to walk down memory lane at U-Drop Inn. After dropping Bill off, Jo heads over to Adrian, Texas to Midpoint Café to meet up with Jenifer Lewis, the voice of Flo!

Disney & Pixar’s Cars is racing back into theaters September 4. And watch the Cars Collection now streaming on Disney+.
